system.name: Prompt-CAM
system.one_liner: Learns class-specific prompts for a frozen pre-trained ViT so that its attention maps reveal the traits that tell similar classes apart.

content.variant_note: a central model box with four lettered capability panels around it, all shown on one Scott Oriole photo
content.argues: One frozen ViT with learned class prompts gives classification, trait localization, trait comparison between species and a ranking of the most discriminative traits.
content.subject: A frozen ViT with trainable class prompts and head, and four uses of its outputs on a bird photo.

elements.name: Input Image
elements.role: bird photo fed to the ViT together with the prompts
elements.drawn_as: small photo of a Scott Oriole with a two-line caption below

elements.name: Class-Specific Prompts
elements.role: learned prompt tokens, one per class, fed to the ViT beside the image
elements.drawn_as: red-outlined box holding pastel squares in green, yellow, blue, an ellipsis and lavender, with a flame icon

elements.name: Pre-trained VIT
elements.role: frozen backbone that processes the image and the prompts
elements.drawn_as: large blue rounded box with a white serif label and a snowflake in the corner

elements.name: Head
elements.role: prediction head that turns the outputs of the class prompts into scores
elements.drawn_as: small red-brown box with a flame icon, above the ViT

elements.name: (a) Image Classification
elements.role: classification from the output logits of the class-specific prompts
elements.drawn_as: rounded panel with a logit bar chart and a class box, cream caption tag below

elements.name: Class: Scott Oriole
elements.role: the predicted class shown next to the logits
elements.drawn_as: plain white box with a thin frame

elements.name: (b) Trait Localization
elements.role: attention maps queried by the true-class prompt show where the traits are
elements.drawn_as: rounded panel with the input photo and four heat-map tiles titled Trait 1 to Trait 4, cream caption tag below

elements.name: (c) Trait Comparison
elements.role: attention maps queried by another class's prompt show traits shared between species
elements.drawn_as: rounded panel with two question rows, cream caption tag below

elements.name: What's common between Brewer Blackbird and Scott Oriole? / Baltimore Oriole
elements.role: question that names which other class's prompt queries the Scott Oriole image
elements.drawn_as: two question blocks with class names tinted in the prompt colours, each between the other species' photo and the Scott Oriole photo, followed by a double arrow and two heat maps

elements.name: (d) Species-specific Trait Ranking
elements.role: masking the least important heads until the true-class probability collapses leaves the most discriminative traits
elements.drawn_as: rounded panel with a line plot, two callouts, two heat maps and the input photo, cream caption tag below

elements.name: Att. head-1 / Att. head-11
elements.role: the two attention heads left at the end of the masking
elements.drawn_as: rounded white callouts with grey arrows to the last curve points, beside two heat maps

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the model once in a central box, with snowflake and flame icons for what is frozen and what is trained, then fan elbow arrows out to lettered panels that each show one use on the same input photo. Carry one pastel colour per class from prompt tokens to bars to tinted names.
lessons.suits: Papers whose single trained component supports several analyses, such as classification, localisation, comparison and ranking, that can all be shown on one example.

evidence: We keep the whole pre-trained ViT frozen and only optimize the C tokens and the shared scoring vector.
PROMPT-CAM enables trait localization by visualizing the multi-head attention maps queried by the true-class prompt.
by systematically masking out the least important attention heads

summary: Prompt-CAM makes a pre-trained Vision Transformer interpretable by learning one prompt per class and reading the scores from the class-specific prompts. Figure 1 puts the model in a central rounded box: the input image and a row of coloured class-prompt tokens, marked with a flame as trained, go into a blue Pre-trained ViT, marked with a snowflake as frozen, which feeds a trainable Head. Elbow arrows lead to four lettered corner panels, all on one Scott Oriole photo: (a) class logits as coloured bars, (b) four attention-map tiles for trait localization, (c) comparison with Brewer Blackbird and Baltimore Oriole prompts, with class names tinted in the prompt colours, and (d) a probability curve as attention heads are masked, leaving heads 1 and 11.
summary_zh: Prompt-CAM 为预训练ViT学习类别专属提示，使其可解释。图1中央为模型框（雪花标冻结的ViT，火焰标可训练的提示与分类头），折线箭头通向(a)分类、(b)特征定位、(c)特征对比、(d)特征排序四个面板，均用同一张黄鹂照片。
notes: The central model box is framed but untitled and is counted as a fifth panel. The colour-to-class mapping is read from matching colours (class-name highlights in (c) match prompt-token colours); the link from the logit bars to classes is implied. The probability curve is probably a bitmap because its tick labels are not in the live text layer. The pastel green is an approximate reading.
